code_summary: ocmseserviceui route/route.ts (payment and furnish only), pages/Payment/Payment.ts, pages/Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts as other features that are not counted. No bank account submission code in any of the six repos
note: Status in stories.json: No requirement (URA's requirement text is not given). The story asks that after the offender confirms submitting bank account details via the unique URL, the page shows whether the submission succeeded. No code: since the bank account form and its submit endpoint do not exist (see OCMS51.1), there is no bank submission result page. Only payment/success and payment/failure (route.ts:27-36) and the furnish Acknowledgement (Furnish/Acknowledgement.ts) exist, two other features that are not bank account submission, so they are not counted. URA's side: cannot verify from repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. The submission result page depends on the form and submit that do not exist. Ask URA/the team where the code lives, or mark as gap

steps.step: The offender confirms submitting the bank account details via the unique URL
steps.detail: No route, confirmation page or submit button for bank accounts in the eservice (route.ts:15-41 has only payment and furnish-particulars).

steps.step: The system processes the submission and returns the result (success/failure)
steps.detail: No controller, service or repository for bank account submission in ocmseserviceapi (grep bank/account/payee is empty); the only submit endpoint is the furnish /furnishapplication (FurnishSubmissionController.java:66). No bank processing result exists.

steps.step: The page displays that the submission was successful
steps.detail: The existing success page (payment/success, route.ts:27-31, and Payment.ts) belongs to the payment flow, not bank account submission. A generic mechanism exists but is not what the story names, and without a submission there is no bank success condition. Not counted.
